environment.description: Flask application deployed on RHEL 9 host with SELinux in enforcing mode. Process runs under custom confined SELinux type 'flask_extract_t' with MCS category c0.c128. The type enforcement policy grants write access exclusively to paths labeled 'flask_data_t' (applied only to /var/app/uploads and /var/app/extracted and their subdirectories via fcontext regex). Transitions from flask_extract_t to unconfined types are denied by constraint. The MLS/MCS range prevents cross-category access. Additionally, the process runs under a systemd unit with ProtectSystem=strict and ReadWritePaths limited to /var/app/uploads and /var/app/extracted. File context restoration runs via restorecond watching /var/app.
